**Newsletter: Recycled Paper Print Shop Launch**

Starting May 8, our print shop accepts recycled paper. We encourage artists to bring a sample. This change not only supports the environment but also offers a unique print option. For more details, visit our website or contact us.

Dear Art Community,

Starting May 8, our print shop accepts recycled paper for all your projects. We're excited to support artists by offering sustainable materials. Please bring a sample to try out our new eco-friendly options. Thanks for choosing us!
